title: Ines and the House
author: G. M. Pemberton
blurb: Hazel Winterbourne, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
